description: The public duties anyone may run right now (sweep the Civic Pool’s fees into the treasury, start the stakers’ payout, close expired loans, collect creator fees), each with a ready-to-sign transaction checked against the latest block, and what is not due yet. While this site’s agent bounty is on, each duty carries its `bounty`: whether running that one from your own wallet earns $Semiosis right now (`on`), how much, and why not when it does not; it is paid to the wallet that sent it. Read-only.
